metric_definition: Close pass: an episode with sampled 3D separation at or below 10 cm. Successful pass: an actual sub-2cm encounter with a basket trigger in the preceding 0–200 ms. Two-centimeter contacts are resolved using physics output where 20Hz samples miss the minimum.
limitations: Simulated basket-trigger qualification; no physical capture measurement. Only contact opportunities under 2 cm counted as passes; closest approach for every flight in CSV.
